name: overcode
description: Extends AIDD with project-agnostic workflows: research; memory maintenance; repository-backed Markdown freshness with AIDD-routed code checks (taste); AIDD-routed document/code foresight plus dependency abandonment and migration horizon (foresee); behavioural testing; test governance; performance, data, ActivityPub, and SEO/GEO audits; project health; plain-language explanations; documentation; and planning utilities. Stack knowledge remains pivot-driven through sc-* plugins, and AIDD delegation fails explicitly when a required capability is unavailable. Alias chains: rechallenge, endtask, bump-plugin, previously, smarten, skillconf, weeklyemail, gitit, mirror, codex-vision, backlog.

interface.longDescription: Adds project-agnostic research, maintenance, documentation freshness, dependency-horizon analysis, behavioral testing, performance, SEO, data, and planning workflows with explicit AIDD delegation receipts.
defaultPrompt: Research this topic with cross-referenced sources
